result: WP807 currently compares caller-supplied holdout_set_id strings but does not bind that identity to benchmark_id, fixture-family provenance, run descriptor, reconciliation content or receipt content. Four mutually different benchmark_id values can therefore satisfy the encoded shared-holdout condition if they reuse one holdout label and all other thresholds pass.
minimal_correction: Do not force benchmark_id equality. Bind one shared_fixture_family_sha256 (or admitted successor identity) mechanically to exact upstream evidence and require exact equality across the four inner CapabilityEvidence records; otherwise return NOT_EVALUABLE.
cross_family_relation: After inner shared-family provenance is repaired, evaluate multiple independently bound family digests through the E2 outer GeneralizationBundleEvidence proposal.
next_gate: E4 repository-hosted negative control: same text holdout label, distinct provenance-bound family identities; current source should reproduce the gap and repaired source must fail closed.
mirror_policy: Provenance mirror only; F2 remains canonical claim/result authority.
